transferMechanism.notes: California is not an NLC member, so the CA nurse holds no multistate license to leverage. TXBON Rule 217.1(12): endorsement is 'the process of issuing a permanent license without further examination to a nurse from another jurisdiction... after determination is made that the applicant meets the same standards as those required of Texas nurses.'

endorsementProcess.value: Submit online endorsement application via the Texas Nurse Portal per Rule 217.5(a) eligibility criteria; requires Nursys license verification, fingerprinting, and passing the Texas Nursing Jurisprudence Exam.
